svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Totem, Farcaster and X: what lives where
svg.desc: Three zones. X on the left: your X account, your X archive, and the paid X developer API. Totem in the middle: your private root and personas, find your people, who sees what, a history shelf for imported tweets, readwise and folders, the anon composer, influence and tiers, feed controls, private posts and show to a friend. Farcaster on the right: X verifications, your main account, persona accounts, the anon account and public casts. Eleven numbered arrows connect them; the key at the bottom names each and its status.

g.text: Totem, Farcaster and X: what lives where
Totem sits in the middle: your private side. Farcaster, on the right, is the public network. Numbers match the key below.
your private side: you, your personas, your rules
paid per use, no free tier
your tweets keep their original X dates, inside Totem
they see it in Totem only
you verify your X in the Farcaster app
both running Totem sites. “Built, test data
only” also covers parts that are built

Post to X, sync bookmarks, sign in with X. Waits for a yes.
